messages:
maria: Heads-up — a customer hit a runtime crash when importing the SDK from a Cloudflare Worker: `TypeError: Redwood is not a function`.
jamal: Any repro steps? which bundler/version?
maria: Wrangler + rollup + rollup-plugin-node-resolve. They do a simple `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'` and the bundle loads our CJS output in the worker, so shape mismatch.
lia: That tracks. Our package.json currently had a flat exports pointing at CJS, so ESM-first runtimes pick the wrong file. Also their TS complained: our types used `export =` which confuses modern ESM TS configs.
jamal: More worrying — the CJS build still uses the old fetch+retry shim; the ESM build uses the native fetch retry hook. Customers saw auth retries silently fail because the worker environment didn't have the node polyfill.
thomas: Quick plan: publish conditional exports so bundlers/runtime can choose correctly. Example we should use: \"exports\": { \".\": { \"import\": \"./dist/index.mjs\", \"require\": \"./dist/index.cjs.js\" }, \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\" }. Keep `main` -> CJS and `module` -> ESM for backward compatibility.
lia: I'll update the .d.ts to be ESM-friendly (default + named exports) instead of `export =`. That should fix TS resolution in edge projects.
maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1256 — includes conditional exports, types fix, and changelog. I published a release candidate to `next` tag: 0.11.2-rc.1.
jamal: Can we add a CI smoke test to catch this? I propose a tiny sample-app workflow that runs rollup/esbuild + miniflare to bundle and run the worker import.
ci-bot: new workflow created: .github/workflows/edge-smoke.yml triggered on PRs.
thomas: Good. Also add a runtime guard so if `globalThis.fetch` is missing we fall back to a safe no-op retry adapter instead of throwing — lowers blast radius for older bundles.
lia: Pushed typing tweak to the PR: `declare const Redwood: ...; export default Redwood; export { helperA, helperB };` keeps CJS compatibility while being ESM-friendly.
maria: Docs note added to sample-apps: troubleshooting section says to check `exports` and, as a temporary workaround, import the explicit ESM build path: `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference/dist/index.mjs'`.
jamal: I'll add a minimal repro in sample-apps and wire the smoke test to run on `next` tag install.
maria: After we merge and ship patch to `latest` we should reach out to the reporting customer with the RC and offer to validate.
thomas: Sequence: land PR, merge edge CI, publish patch to latest, notify affected customers.
maria: Action items: @jamal add smoke test + sample repro; @lia finalize typings; @thomas coordinate publish; I'll update onboarding checklist to include edge bundler import test in sample-apps validation.
lia: One more thing — mention in changelog that this is a compatibility fix for edge runtimes and TS ESM resolution so customers upgrade if they run into import shape issues.
maria: OK closing; follow-ups in the PR. :thumbsup:
